PUBG is the best battle royale game. But, like everything else, it's not without its downsides.

1. Even if you jumped out of the plane first, that doesn't mean some other قاتل مستجد won't land before you and suck your soul out before you even hit the ground.

2. Even if you're lucky enough to fall into a house where you're miraculously alone, that doesn't guarantee you'll find anything in that house or the neighboring houses other than a crossbow and a grenade.

3. Even if you manage to find loot and somehow survive the first location, towards the middle of the game, when you're driving across the field with your team, you'll be shot, blown up, and destroyed with the precision of a laser annihilator by those same aspiring killers who inhabit PUBG.

Other than that, it's a really cool and addictive game.
